caption: The drawing depicts a metal container with a wide, conical body and a flat, circular lid. The container has a dark, mottled surface in various shades of brown, gray, and black, suggesting it is made of aged metal. Around the base of the cone, there are eight cylindrical spouts spaced evenly apart, each projecting outward at an angle. The tops of the spouts have a lighter, almost white coloration at the tips, with tan, fibrous-looking material emerging from each, resembling wicks. A thin wire handle, with a round loop at the top, is attached to either side of the container and arches above the lid. The drawing is rendered on a light beige background, and the artist's name "FRANKLIN SYRES" is inscribed in small capital letters near the bottom right corner.
title: Lard Oil Lamp
